statement: At least one of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford on 2026-09-27 is charged with a criminal offence, with the charge publicly announced between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-12.
resolution: TRUE if Counter Terrorism Policing, the Metropolitan Police, or the Crown Prosecution Service publicly announces criminal charges against at least one of the five Fairford arrestees, with the announcement dated between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-12 inclusive.
failure_condition: No criminal charge against any of the five Fairford arrestees is announced by 2026-10-12, including if all five are released, bailed, or released under investigation.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The FBI, the US Department of Justice, or the US Treasury Department publicly attributes the September 2026 theft of roughly 387 million dollars in crypto assets from Bitget to North Korean state actors, in a publication dated between 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if a publication on fbi.gov, ic3.gov, justice.gov, or home.treasury.gov dated between 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-13 names Bitget and attributes the theft to North Korean, DPRK, Lazarus, or TraderTraitor actors.
failure_condition: No FBI, DOJ, or Treasury publication dated inside the window attributes the Bitget theft to North Korean actors; attributions by Bitget itself or by private analytics firms do not count.
